title: Youthful insight: Nitrogen sequestration in larvae provides clues to coral bleaching
content:
by Christian R. Voolstra

Impaired nutrient cycling under thermal stress foregoes coral bleaching, the loss of symbiotic algae. A new study in PLOS Biology sheds light on how coral larvae avoid bleaching through nitrogen sequestration to uphold glucose translocation from their algal symbionts.
